title: Christmas in July, then going out of business
lede: hhgregg advertised heavily on local television. These are its spots as uploaded by viewers, its agency and the company itself, and Indianapolis news coverage of the end. Where a date comes only from the uploader, the caption says so.

videos.title: hhgregg “Christmas in July” commercial
videos.caption: A summer sale spot from the expansion years, when the chain went from 131 to 173 stores.[^2] The 2010 date is the uploader’s.

videos.title: hhgregg “I’m Stuffed” commercial
videos.caption: A spot uploaded by Hinge, the agency that posted several hhgregg campaigns. The upload is about seven years old; the air date is not given, and the year shown is approximate.

videos.title: WTHR: hhgregg files for Chapter 11, finds buyer
videos.caption: Indianapolis station WTHR on the March 6, 2017 filing, when the company said it had a buyer lined up.[^8]

videos.title: hhgregg: “Going out of business — total liquidation”
videos.caption: The liquidation advertisement, uploaded to the company’s own YouTube channel. The sales began on April 8, 2017.[^10]

videos.title: WRTV: hhgregg liquidation begins
videos.caption: Local news from Indianapolis as the closing sales started in April 2017.[^10]

videos.title: Company Man: The decline of hhgregg
videos.caption: A popular retrospective. Embedded as commentary; no figure on this page is taken from it. The year is approximate, from the upload age YouTube shows.
